The '''National Fuel Gas Supply Corporation Gas Pipeline''' is an operating gas pipeline in the United States.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.nationalfuel.com/pipeline-storage/about-pipeline/natural-gas-infrastructure/|title=Natural Gas Infrastructure {{!}} National Fuel Gas Company|website=www.nationalfuel.com|access-date=2024-09-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline system operates in New York and Pennsylvania.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://rextag.com/pipeline/national-fuel-gas-supply|title=National Fuel Gas Supply|website=rextag.com|access-date=2024-09-04}}</ref>

==Background==

=== Main Line ===
The National Fuel Gas Supply Corporation Gas Pipeline system is a medium-size pipeline system that operates in New York and Pennsylvania.<ref name=":1" /> The system includes 31 compressor stations.<ref name=":1" />

=== FM 100 Project ===
The National Fuel Gas Supply Corporation (National Fuel) has proposed an expansion project to modernize a segment of its system in McKean, Potter, Elk, Clearfield and Cameron counties in Pennsylvania. The project includes the installation of approximately 28.9 miles of new 12 or 16-inch pipeline in Sergeant, Norwich, and Liberty Townships in McKean County, and Roulette, Pleasant Valley, Clara, Hebron Townships in Potter County, installation of the new Marvindale natural gas compressor station in Sergeant Township in McKean County, and installation of a new interconnection in Hebron Township in Potter County, Pennsylvania.<ref name="natfuel">[https://www.natfuel.com/pipelineandstorage/supply/FM100/Nov_13Presentation.pdf FM 100 Modernization Project] National Fuel, November 13, 2017</ref>

As of July 2020, National Fuel had applied for approval with the Federal Energy Regulatory Agency and a decision is pending.<ref name="eia">[https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php Natural Gas Data, Pipeline Projects] Energy Information Agency, accessed July 21, 2020</ref>

According to the EIA, as of April 2021 the project was under construction.<ref name="eiaapr21">[https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php U.S. natural gas pipeline projects], U.S. Energy Information Administration, April 29, 2021</ref>

The project was completed in December 2021.<ref name="eiaapr21" />

=== Tioga Pathway Expansion ===
This expansion was proposed to build build and replace a total of 23.42 mi of new and existing pipeline, transporting gas from Tioga County, PA to locations in the United States and Canada.<ref name=":3" /> Construction was estimated to begin in 2025.<ref name=":3" />
